mechanism: Add a backend-level inverse-DFT-to-torus plus addend callback so the add-back is performed during the inverse materialization store, not as a second torus-polynomial pass.

risk: Backend-specific, may require spqlios/AVX512 code paths and may be neutral if FFT arithmetic dominates memory traffic.

mechanism: Keep each bit-window output in DFT form and materialize after the whole window rather than inside each CMUX.
distinct_from_prior: Different schedule lifetime, but not selected.
expected_bound: It does not reduce the number of inverse DFTs because the next SAB bit consumes torus-domain samples; it also requires an array of DFT temporaries across many accumulator slots.
risk: Large memory footprint and cache pressure; likely worsens the full SAB path unless a separate DFT-domain accumulator design is proven.
required_gate: New memory model and scratch allocator before any code.

mechanism: Fuse paired direct/NCMUX butterfly calls that share one input sample to reduce repeated torus loads in the sub stage.
distinct_from_prior: Targets the butterfly pair before MAT EP, not the from_DFT/add epilogue.
expected_bound: sub is 13.41% of full body; even halving sub has an Amdahl ceiling of 1.072x.
risk: Pairing is irregular at bit boundaries and NCMUX includes an automorphism; implementation complexity may exceed expected gain.
required_gate: Per-bit phase equivalence plus full-SAB A/B if C1 fails.
